---
name: Source change
about: Report a changed or broken PiRC / Pi source
title: "[Source] "
assignees: ""
---

## Source

Which source ID from `evidence/SOURCES.md`? (For example: `S1`.)

## Old pin

Commit, date, and URL used in the repository.

## New location

Commit, date, and URL of the changed source.

## What changed

Quote the old line and the new line. If the change is editorial, say so. If it
changes a formula or a capability, say which proposal is affected.

## Impact

- [ ] No impact; the pin can be updated.
- [ ] The proposal needs a clarification.
- [ ] The proposal needs a new version.
- [ ] The proposal should be withdrawn.

## Evidence

Link to the exact file and line. Do not rely on a screenshot.
